sloka: परिक्लांतस्य मे तात पक्षौ चित्त्वा निशाचरः ।सीताम् आदाय वैदेहीम् प्रयातो दक्षिणा मुखः ॥३-६८-१०॥
transliteration: pariklāṁtasya me tāta pakṣau cittvā niśācaraḥ ।sītām ādāya vaidehīm prayāto dakṣiṇā mukhaḥ ॥3-68-10॥

translations.english: O my child when I was exhausted, that demon cut off my wings and carried Sita off in the southern direction.
